div.head: Leis Wl 1.1
div.ab: E si aucuns meist main en celui ki la mere iglise requereit, si ceo fust u evesqué u abeie u iglise de religiun, rendist ceo qu’il avreit pris, e cent souz le forfeit; e de mere iglise de parosse XX souz; e de chapele X souz.

E se alquons meist main en celui qui la mere yglise requireit, se ceo fust u evesqué u abbeie u yglise de religion, rendist ceo que il i avereit pris e cent solz de forfait; e de mere yglise de paroisse XX solz; e de chapele X solz.

Quodsi quis in eum manus iniecerit uiolentas et ecclesie immunitatem fregerit, inprimis restituat plenarie ablata et insuper de forisfacto, si cathedralis fuerit ecclesia uel cenobium uel quecunque religiosorum ecclesia, centum solid., si matrix ecclesia parochialis XX solid., si capella X solid.

E si aucuns meist main en celui ki la mere iglise requereit, si ceo fust u evesqué u abeie u iglise de religiun, rendist ceo qu'il avreit pris e cent souz le forfeit, e de mere iglise de parosse XX souz, e de chapele X souz.

1, 1. Und wenn jemand Hand an denjenigen legte, der die Mutter Kirche [als Asyl] aufsuchte, wenn dies Bistum oder Abtei oder Ordenskirche wäre, gebe er heraus, was er (dort I) genommen hat, und 100 Schilling Busse; und bei einer Pfarrei-Mutterkirche 20 Schilling und bei einer Kapelle 10 Schilling.

1, 1. And if anyone laid hands on him who sought mother church [as asylum], if this were a bishopric or abbey or church of religion, he shall give back what he has taken (there I), and 100 shillings compensation; and in the case of a parish mother-church 20 shillings and in the case of a chapel 10 shillings.

And if anyone has laid hands on a man who has sought a mother church, whether it be a bishop's church or an abbey or a monastic church, he shall pay for anything he has taken away and a fine of 100 shillings, and in the case of the mother church of a parish he shall pay 20 shillings, and of a chapel 10 shillings.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 252–253 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 492–493, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

in the sense of motherly, dear
den Verfolgten allein kann das Neutrum nicht meinen, sondern ausserdem wohl was er an Werth bei sich trug, was den nach Busse gierigen Verfolger reizte
the neuter cannot mean the pursued man alone, but probably also whatever of value he carried with him, which tempted the pursuer greedy for compensation
Verf. meint unter Schilling schlechthin meist 12 Pfennig (ausser 11, 1 f. 19. 42, 1), anders als Cnut. Ob auch hier?
By ‘shilling’ without qualification the author mostly means 12 pence (except 11, 1 f. 19. 42, 1), unlike Cnut. Here too?

Cnuts 5 £ = 100 Schill. Normannisch. Statt 60 und 30 Schill. Cnuts setzt Verf. 20 und 10, indem er Cnuts Schilling (s. d. Gl 6b) als Mercisch zu 4 Pf. irrig ansieht. Vgl. Gl Asylbruch 5.—Ändere o. I 493 in 1, 1{b}: ‘Pfennig (dass er 11, 1f. 19. 42, 1 den zu 4 Pf. meint, sagt er), anders als Cnut. So auch hier, denn 100 Schill. Norm. = 5 £ (Cnuts)’

Cnut's 5 £ = 100 shill. Norman. Instead of Cnut's 60 and 30 shill. the author puts 20 and 10, wrongly regarding Cnut's shilling (see that word in Gl 6b) as Mercian at 4 pence. Cf. Gl Asylbruch 5.—Alter above I 493 at 1, 1{b} to: ‘pence (that in 11, 1f. 19. 42, 1 he means the one at 4 pence, he says himself), unlike Cnut. So too here, for 100 shill. Norm. = 5 £ (Cnut's)’
